cases.title: Linux service outage
cases.brief: A simulated report service stopped after a scheduled update. Identify the evidence and choose a safe recovery recommendation.
commands: /var/reports/output owner=root group=reports mode=750; service account=reporter; groups=reporter
10:01 package update; 10:03 directory owner changed from reporter to root
remediation: Restore the approved service access using a reviewed permission change, then retest
cases.explanation: The mock journal and directory permissions support a permission mismatch. Confirm approved ownership/privileges and verify service plus normal access after a controlled correction.

cases.title: Windows login alert
cases.brief: A fictional shared Windows PC reports failed authentication. Determine what the evidence supports.
commands: 13:00 login_failed user=student; 13:01 login_failed user=student; 13:06 login_success user=student
12:55 Defender signatures updated; no malware alert
student: standard user, enabled; admin: separate account
Host reachable; no unusual egress recorded in supplied window
diagnoses: Only login attempts and success are established; intent unknown
remediation: Review activity with the account owner and preserve relevant event records
cases.explanation: Authentication records do not establish who performed the action. Scoped review with the owner is proportionate; avoid claiming a breach.

cases.title: DNS and gateway failure
cases.brief: A synthetic training client connects to Wi-Fi, but a course portal hostname does not work.
commands: 192.168.50.1 reachable; no packet loss in mock test
Second approved lab client uses DNS 192.168.50.54 and resolves correctly
diagnoses: Configured DNS resolver is the likely failure point
remediation: Verify and correct the authorized resolver setting, then retest DNS and site access
cases.explanation: A valid IP, working gateway and alternate working resolver support a scoped DNS configuration hypothesis.
